digest.component_or_area: overlap detection judge / batch verdict pipeline
propositions: Batch-path verdicts from judge_batch systematically return confidence=0.0 despite successful execution and real relation values, causing aggregate to reject all pairs below the 0.7 threshold and surface zero findings
Output token limit of 1024 bytes truncates multi-candidate batches (K up to 20 → 10-pair batches), causing the entire batch to be abstained instead of partially evaluated
The batch entry JSON schema omits required fields for candidate_id, relation, and confidence, allowing the model to default confidence to 0.0 and produce malformed multi-entry tool arguments
Live calibration probe confirms near-duplicate pairs now surface with confidence >= 0.7 after fixing the contract required fields and scaling output budget to 256 + 192*n tokens
